page.notes: The woodcut initial "D" is read as "E" in the first word "E Duellis" (the initial is a large decorative D; the word reads "De Duellis", with the D rendered by the initial). The word "actur​us" and "factu​rum" contain soft hyphen-like gaps; the printed text reads "acturus" and "facturum" with a line-end gap, and "crisin" reads as printed. The word "cum" in bold is not bold in the original and should be plain. Words "ejusdem", "quę", "crisin" are as printed. The marginal "E" at the left is a signature-like mark and the "A" at the foot is a signature.
